svg.title: How L-Compute removes Mamba projection SRAM bank conflicts
svg.desc: A side-by-side paper figure using the exact Nemotron 3 x packet. In row-major placement, every one of eight head rows maps four requested lanes to banks zero through three. With L_SCATTER_M, every head row is shifted by four banks, so the same thirty-two logical values are balanced two per bank across sixteen single-port banks.
svg.text: Why L-Compute Eliminates Mamba Projection-SRAM Bank Conflicts
Exact x-field packet for one Nemotron 3 group: X_STATE requests 8 heads × 4 adjacent P-lanes = 32 values from 16 single-port banks
because each 64-value head row starts again at bank 0
Bank selected for each logical value
Correct packet, but the four hot banks serialize X_STATE reads
shift each head row by 4 banks
the logical tensor and P-lane order do not change
Bank selected for each logical value
Same packet, balanced across all banks at the 32/16 lower bound
Only the physical (row, bank) placement changes. Every source remains unique, no tensor value is modified, and X_STATE reconstructs the original logical packet order from the descriptor.
